# Plugin API v1

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_plugin_api_docs.py from shape.plugins.api.v1 -->

`SHAPE_API = "1.0"`. A plugin module declares its own `SHAPE_API = "1.x"`;
the host rejects any other major version. Plugins are trusted, in-process code.
Hooks take and return whole Arrow batches or arrays, never single values or rows.
A plugin satisfies a Protocol structurally; it does not import or subclass it.
What stays stable within 1.x, what counts as a breaking change and how deprecation works
are in [stability.md](stability.md).

| Entry-point group | Protocol |
|---|---|
| `shape.sources` | `Source` |
| `shape.sinks` | `Sink` |
| `shape.detectors` | `SemanticDetector` |
| `shape.fitters` | `DistributionFitter` |
| `shape.strategies` | `Strategy` |
| `shape.distributions` | `Distribution` |
| `shape.calendars` | `Calendar` |
| `shape.domains` | `Domain` |
| `shape.chaos` | `ChaosMutator` |
| `shape.emitters` | `Emitter` |
| `shape.stream_sources` | `StreamSource` |
| `shape.transforms` | `Transform` |
| `shape.commands` | `Command` |
| `shape.reports` | `ReportFormat` |
| `shape.behaviors` | `Behavior` |

## `Source`

Entry-point group `shape.sources`.

A URI or scheme to a ``RecordBatch`` iterator.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `schemes: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `can_open(self, uri: str) -> bool`
- `schema(self, uri: str, **options: Any) -> pa.Schema`
- `read(self, uri: str, **options: Any) -> Iterator[pa.RecordBatch]`

## `Sink`

Entry-point group `shape.sinks`.

``RecordBatch``es for one table to a destination.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `schemes: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `write(self, uri: str, table: str, batches: Iterable[pa.RecordBatch], **options: Any) -> int`

## `SemanticDetector`

Entry-point group `shape.detectors`.

An array to a ``(label, confidence)`` or ``None`` when nothing matches.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `detect(self, values: pa.Array, column: str) -> Detection | None`

## `DistributionFitter`

Entry-point group `shape.fitters`.

A sample array to a family, its parameters and the KS statistic.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `families: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `fit(self, sample: pa.Array) -> FitResult | None`

## `Strategy`

Entry-point group `shape.strategies`.

A column spec and a context to an Arrow array for one chunk.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `generate(self, spec: Mapping[str, Any], ctx: GenerationContext) -> pa.Array`

## `Distribution`

Entry-point group `shape.distributions`.

Parameters and an RNG stream to an array.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `sample(self, params: Mapping[str, float], ctx: GenerationContext) -> pa.Array`

## `Calendar`

Entry-point group `shape.calendars`.

A date range to per-date lift factors (1.0 means no change).

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `lift(self, start: date, end: date) -> pa.Array`

## `Domain`

Entry-point group `shape.domains`.

A schema with reference data, profiles and scale presets.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

## `ChaosMutator`

Entry-point group `shape.chaos`.

A batch to a mutated batch plus a report. Deterministic given ``seed``.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `mutate(self, batch: pa.RecordBatch, seed: int) -> tuple[pa.RecordBatch, ChaosReport]`

## `Emitter`

Entry-point group `shape.emitters`.

Event batches to an external stream.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `schemes: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `emit(self, uri: str, batches: Iterable[pa.RecordBatch], **options: Any) -> int`

## `StreamSource`

Entry-point group `shape.stream_sources`.

Offsets and batches from an external stream.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `schemes: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `read(self, uri: str, start: StreamOffset | None = None, **options: Any) -> Iterator[tuple[StreamOffset, pa.RecordBatch]]`

## `Transform`

Entry-point group `shape.transforms`.

Tables to tables.

Attributes:

- `name: str`

Methods:

- `apply(self, tables: Mapping[str, pa.Table], **options: Any) -> dict[str, pa.Table]`

## `Command`

Entry-point group `shape.commands`.

A ``shape <name>`` subcommand.

``configure`` adds the command's arguments to its argparse sub-parser; ``run`` receives the
parsed namespace and returns the process exit code.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `help: str`

Methods:

- `configure(self, parser: Any) -> None`
- `run(self, args: Any) -> int`

## `ReportFormat`

Entry-point group `shape.reports`.

A report to bytes.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `extension: str`

Methods:

- `render(self, report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes`

## `Behavior`

Entry-point group `shape.behaviors`.

A behavior (state-machine) module: what happens to simulated entities over time.

``states`` are the state names the module uses; ``attributes`` the entity attributes it reads
or writes; ``events`` the event kinds it emits. ``simulate`` runs ``population`` entities for
``years`` virtual years from a fixed origin and returns the timestamped events as one Arrow
table, deterministically for a ``seed``. The table has at least the columns ``entity_id``
(integer), ``time`` (timestamp), ``state`` and ``kind`` (strings): ``kind`` is one of
``events`` and ``state`` one of ``states``; engine rows that belong to no state (an entity
reaching the end of its lifetime) carry an empty ``state`` and the kind ``entity_end``.

Attributes:

- `name: str`
- `version: str`
- `states: Sequence[str]`
- `attributes: Sequence[str]`
- `events: Sequence[str]`

Methods:

- `simulate(self, population: int, seed: int, years: float) -> pa.Table`

## Data types

### `ChaosReport`

What a mutator changed in one batch.

- `mutator: str`
- `rows_affected: int`
- `details: Mapping[str, Any]`

### `Detection`

A semantic label for a column, with a confidence in [0, 1].

- `label: str`
- `confidence: float`

### `DomainDefinition`

What a domain contributes: schema, reference data, profiles and scale presets.

``validated`` is optional and off by default: a plugin sets it only when it has checked
``schema`` against ``generation-schema-v1.json`` itself (a packaged domain compares a content
digest with the one recorded when the schema was checked) and the document holds only JSON
types. The host then skips its own check; without it every schema is checked.

- `schema: Mapping[str, Any]`
- `reference_data: Mapping[str, pa.Table]`
- `profiles: Mapping[str, Any]`
- `scale_presets: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, int]]`
- `validated: bool`

### `FitResult`

A fitted distribution: family, parameters and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic.

- `family: str`
- `params: Mapping[str, float]`
- `ks: float`

### `GenerationContext`

What a strategy or distribution needs to build one chunk, deterministically.

``seed`` is the run seed; ``table``, ``column`` and ``chunk`` key the RNG stream so the
result does not depend on the chunk layout. ``row_start`` and ``n_rows`` locate the chunk.
``columns`` holds already-generated columns of the same chunk that this column may use.

- `seed: int`
- `table: str`
- `column: str`
- `chunk: int`
- `row_start: int`
- `n_rows: int`
- `columns: Mapping[str, pa.Array]`

### `StreamOffset`

An opaque, JSON-serialisable position in an external stream.

- `value: Mapping[str, Any]`
